function: Channel estimation of the user-to-IRS channel: a CNN denoises the angular-domain channel obtained by ADMM-MMV compressed sensing from active-element measurements (pp. 1-3).
system: TDD massive MIMO: 16-antenna BS, single-antenna user, active (semi-passive) UPA IRS, 64 elements by default (48 active, one RF chain); 28 GHz, 100 MHz (pp. 2, 5).
method: Supervised feature-fusion CNN (FSCNN): two 64x3x3 convolutions, two fused conv blocks, global average pooling, two FC layers; normalized-error loss on angular-domain labels (pp. 4-5).
data_channel: Custom simulated geometric mmWave channel: 6 paths, AoA/AoD uniform in [-pi/2, pi/2], 28 GHz; 20,000 samples, 90% train, 10% test (pp. 2, 5).
test_conditions: Held-out 10% of the same simulated data; NMSE swept over SNR, IRS size, active elements, paths and BS antennas, with no stated test on unseen settings (pp. 5-7).
baselines: Non-learned: SOMP, LAOMP, ADMM-MMV (own first stage); learned: CNN-based two-stage estimator [14], GARN-based global attention residual network [17] (pp. 5-7).
metrics: NMSE in dB versus SNR, number of IRS elements, number of activated elements, multipath components and BS antennas; training loss versus iterations (pp. 5-7).
q1_support: p. 2: "it can be modeled as the geometric"; custom geometric mmWave simulator (6 paths, uniform angles, p. 5), no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 5: "90% is used for model training and 10%"; the test set is held out from the same data, and Figs. 5-10 sweep SNR, IRS size, active elements, paths and BS antennas without stating a test on settings unseen in training.
q3_support: p. 5: "GARN-based [17], CNN-based [14], LAOMP [18]"; with SOMP [19] and ADMM-MMV, so non-learned and learned baselines, all compared on NMSE (Figs. 5-10).
q4_support: p. 4: "enhance computational efficiency and reducing the number of"; qualitative claim only, with no parameter count, FLOPs, order of complexity or runtime reported.
q5_support: p. 5: "based on Tensorflow 1.6 in PyCharm 22.3.2 with NVIDIA"; own simulated data, no code or data link.
notes: Two stages: ADMM-MMV (non-learned) gives the angular-domain estimate, then the CNN refines it, so the learned part performs the estimation (p. 3). Area 2. Fig. 4 shows one loss curve per SNR and the input size depends on the IRS size (p. 4), which suggests training per setting, but retraining is not stated.
